responsibility: This file implements the mc front end's lightweight internal debugging helpers. It provides a simple assertion hook that reports an internal compiler error through mcError when an invariant fails and a conditional debug-string writer gated by the internal-debugging option, making it the compiler-support analogue of the runtime Debug module rather than a user-facing diagnostics subsystem.
same_name_distinction: Implements the mcDebug interface from GmcDebug.h, including the assertion helper that routes failures to mcError_internalError and the conditional debug output gated by mcOptions. Unlike the header, it provides the executable debugging behavior rather than just declarations.
